description: Quick pop — element appear/spawn, chip/tag/badge in. Small precise accent, sync to the pop-in.
Punchy whoosh/impact — fast reveal or hard transition accent. Sync to the motion.
Bass impact hit — logo/hero snap, headline slam. Trigger on the visual landing; decay carries into the next shot (J-cut).
Soft melodic chime — gentle positive beat: success/confirmation or a lighthearted transition. Sync to the visual moment.
